response.justification: Bogdan is a technically strong, versatile senior engineer with 15+ years of experience, open-source project ownership, and Linux fluency, but he does not meet the role's explicit language requirement (German C1 vs. his self-reported 'Basic' German), and his resume shows little evidence of formal team leadership, UML/architecture modeling, project management, or IT security/compliance work — all core requirements for this Head of Development / Tech Lead position.
strengths: 15+ years of diverse software development experience across web, mobile, embedded, and backend systems
Strong open-source and Linux background, including founding and maintaining the GISCollective platform
Demonstrated communication and mentoring ability via workshops, talks, and training courses
concerns: German proficiency listed as 'Basic', far below the required C1 minimum
No evidence of UML expertise, formal architecture modeling, or Python skills required for the role
Career history is predominantly individual-contributor/staff-level; little demonstrated experience leading teams, managing projects, or handling IT security/compliance

key_factors.factor: German language requirement not met (C1 needed, only Basic)
Lack of demonstrated team leadership, UML, and project management experience
Strong technical breadth, open-source and Linux experience
